pcs.pc_description: Analyse production orders and customer requirements to develop a comprehensive production plan for crochet lace items.
Estimate and procure raw materials (yarns, threads, hooks, accessories) needed for production, based on the design complexity and volume, ensuring optimal inventory levels.
Schedule tasks and assign specific production stages to individual artisans or groups, considering their skill level and expertise in crochet techniques.
Ensure that artisans are provided with clear work instructions and pattern specifications, minimizing errors and maximizing productivity.
Develop plans for potential production challenges, such as material shortages, artisan absenteeism, or equipment malfunction, to avoid disruption.
Monitor production progress on a daily basis, ensuring products are being manufactured correctly and making adjustments if necessary.
Coordinate with the design team to ensure that the lace patterns and motifs are feasible within the production capabilities and timeframe.
Monitor the entire crochet lace production process to ensure that work is being performed according to the planned schedule and quality standards.
Conduct regular inspections at various stages of production to ensure that patterns, motifs, and designs are being followed accurately by the artisans.
Identify and resolve any production issues, such as design inconsistencies, equipment malfunctions, or delays in workflow, to prevent disruption in the production process.
Provide technical guidance and support to artisans on complex crochet techniques and designs, ensuring consistent skill development and production quality.
Ensure that production tools (crochet hooks, frames, blocking tools) and workstations are properly maintained and set up for efficient operations.
Track production outputs daily to ensure that target volumes and quality parameters are met, and take corrective action when there are discrepancies.
Ensure that quality checks are performed at each critical stage of production, identifying and rectifying defects in design, stitching, or finishing before final product approval.

pcs.pc_description: Set quality control standards for materials, production processes, and finished crochet lace products, ensuring alignment with customer specifications and industry level.
Explain quality control standards effectively to all team members, ensuring their understanding and adherence during the production process.
Regularly review and update quality standards based on feedback, production outcomes, and market trends to ensure continuous improvement.
Collaborate with designers and artisans to ensure that quality standards are feasible and practical within the production context.
Implement a systematic schedule for conducting quality inspections at various stages of the crochet lace production process, including raw material evaluation and final product assessment.
Perform inspections to identify defects, inconsistencies, and differences from established quality standards in both in-process and finished items.
Maintain accurate records of inspection results, documenting any defects found and actions taken to address quality issues.
Provide immediate feedback to artisans during inspections to promote real-time learning and quality awareness.

modules.module_title: Implementing Corrective Actions and Continuous Improvement

pcs.pc_description: Identify and analyse the causes of defects or quality issues, and develop appropriate corrective action plans to address them effectively.
Communicate with team members about identified deficiencies and necessary improvements to foster a collaborative approach to quality enhancement.
Monitor the effectiveness of implemented corrective actions and make adjustments as needed to ensure ongoing compliance with quality standards.
Conduct regular team meetings to discuss quality issues, share insights, and brainstorm solutions for continuous improvement.
